mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a broadening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 30% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level indicates robust supply-side activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5d SPX returns falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 135,000 thousand, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000.0.
